author: Cleo Abram
description:
This glacier is bleeding and they just found something very new and weird inside!

Blood falls was first discovered in 1911 and remained a very unsettling mystery for over 100 years. Finally, when scientists were able to sample the falls they were surprised to find out exactly what turned this water red and the color was the least interesting part…

To find out more, subscribe! 

#Antarctica #Science #BlueIce
title: This Glacier Is Bleeding. It Gets Weirder.
